en: Earned $%d | fish %d | sold %d | trashed %d\nfishers %d porters %d cashiers %d | worker speed Lv%d pile cap Lv%d\nweapon Lv%d | eaten by bear %d | time %s
zh_TW: 累計收入 $%d|抓魚 %d|賣出 %d|丟棄 %d\n漁夫 %d 搬運工 %d 收銀員 %d|工人速度 Lv%d 堆疊上限 Lv%d\n武器 Lv%d|被北極熊吃掉 %d|時間 %s

en: WASD / arrows / left stick to move. Walk into fish to catch; stand on pads to drop / take / stock / serve / trash. Cash on the money pad goes into your wallet; stand on a price pad for a moment to pay. H toggles the hint arrow. Autosave every 10 s; F9 = new game.
zh_TW: WASD / 方向鍵 / 手把左搖桿移動。走進水裡碰到魚就抓;站在格子上自動放貨、拿貨、上架、收銀、丟棄。錢格的錢會收進錢包;在價格牌上站一下就開始付錢。H 開關提示箭頭。每 10 秒自動存檔;F9 重新開始。

en: Hints off (press H to turn on)
zh_TW: 提示已關閉(按 H 開啟)

en: Tutorial done! The arrow keeps hinting; press H to toggle it.
zh_TW: 教學完成!之後箭頭會提示該做什麼，按 H 可開關

en: Walk into the shallows up top and bump into fish (catch 4)
zh_TW: 到上方淺水區，走到魚旁邊就會抓到(抓 4 條)

en: Drop the fish on the cutting table's input pad
zh_TW: 把魚放到切魚台上方的「放這裡」格

en: The worker made fillets. Take them from the output pad
zh_TW: 工人切好了，到下方「從這裡拿」格拿魚片

en: Carry the fillets to the counter's shelf pad
zh_TW: 把魚片拿到櫃台左邊的「上架」格

en: Stand on the serve pad so customers can buy
zh_TW: 站到櫃台下方的「收銀」格，顧客才會買

en: Collect the cash from the money pad
Stand on the %s price pad to buy your first upgrade
zh_TW: 站到「%s」的價格牌上付錢，買第一樣東西

en: Drop the fish at a cutting table
Feed it to the next station
That station is full. Wait for the worker
zh_TW: 工作站滿了，等工人消化

en: The counter is full. Wait for customers
Nowhere to put it. Use the trash
Stock is waiting but nobody is serving. Go stand on the serve pad
zh_TW: 櫃台有貨沒人收銀，去站收銀格

en: Cash is piling up on the money pad
Products are ready at a station. Take them
Press anywhere and drag to walk. Stand on pads to drop / take / stock / serve / pay / trash. Menu is at the top right.
zh_TW: 按住畫面任何地方拖動就會走。站在格子上自動放貨、拿貨、上架、收銀、付錢、丟棄。右上角是選單。

en: Smooth mode: shadows off and lower 3D resolution
zh_TW: 流暢模式:關閉即時陰影、3D 降解析度

en: Fine mode: real-time shadows and full resolution
zh_TW: 精細模式:即時陰影、全解析度

en: The polar bear left: nobody was left to eat
A polar bear! Buy a weapon at the shop outside the village (west gate)
zh_TW: 北極熊來了!快去村外(西邊出口)的武器店買武器

en: Run at the polar bear and hit it until its health bar is empty
zh_TW: 拿著武器衝向北極熊打到牠的血條歸零

en: The Polar Bear King is here! It eats fish and helpers and wrecks any building it chews on for 10 s. Kill it!
zh_TW: 北極熊王來了!牠會吃魚和幫手、咬建築 10 秒就拆掉，快打死牠!

en: The Polar Bear King is down!
Guard tower built! It shoots arrows at polar bears that come near
zh_TW: 守衛塔蓋好了!會朝靠近的北極熊射箭

en: A polar bear wrecked a guard tower! Stand on its base to repair it ($%d)
zh_TW: 北極熊把守衛塔拆了!站到地基上花 $%d 修復

en: The Polar Bear King wrecked the %s! Stand on the rubble to repair it ($%d)
zh_TW: 北極熊王把%s拆了!站到廢墟上花 $%d 修復
